instruction: Identify which slides in my LibreOffice Impress presentation 'Dickinson_Slides.pptx' have speaker notes and save the slide numbers in a Word document called 'slides_with_notes.docx' on the Desktop. List each slide number on a separate line.

metadata.explanation: Task requires identifying which slides have speaker notes and saving the slide numbers to a Word document. Verified by reading the actual PowerPoint file: slides 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, and 9 have speaker notes (8 out of 9 slides; slide 7 has no notes). The evaluator reads the Word document, extracts the slide numbers, and checks if they match the expected list. Gives partial credit: score = max(0, (correct - false_positives) / total_expected).

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic is correct: uses strict regex pattern r'^\s*(\d+)\s*$' to extract only lines containing purely numeric content, preventing false positives from descriptive text
Proper validation: rejects numbers outside reasonable range (1-100) and prevents duplicates
Metric comparison logic is sound: checks exact match first, then provides appropriate partial credit with formula (correct - false_positives) / total_expected
Complete coverage: evaluator checks all required aspects - which slides have notes
Expected values are semantically correct: [1,2,3,4,5,6,8,9] verified from actual PowerPoint file analysis
Data flow is correct: getter extracts list of integers from Word doc, metric compares against expected list
Edge case handling: getter returns empty list if file not found, metric returns 0.0 (semantically correct)
All previously identified issues have been fixed: strict regex, range validation, duplicate prevention
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor improvement: Consider adding postconfig to ensure Word document is saved before verification (e.g., Ctrl+S or close LibreOffice Writer), though most agents naturally save files
